correctness.rationale: For ordinary nonperiodic 6x6 queen attack graph on row-major 36 squares, independent backtracking reproduces exact augmented face-count vector (1,36,340,1024,982,248,4), and the first-vertex toggle pairs the empty face with a singleton and has 1,273 other pairs in the ordinary complex. The 2,635 augmented faces admit the audited global acyclic orientation; critical ordinary cells are 1 vertex, 34 two-cells and 53 three-cells. Independently recomputed signed integral Morse differential has dimensions 34x53, exactly 241 nonzero entries of absolute value <=2, rank over F2=33 and over F3=34; exact unimodular elimination has 33 unit pivots and one remaining row with gcd 2. Hence the Smith data and simply-connected 2-skeleton prove M(Z/2,2) wedge 19 S3, not just field Betti numbers. The audited finite verifier computes the D4 signed fixed-face Lefschetz character (-19,5,-7,5,-1,-1,5,5) and H3 character its negative; the eight character values sum to eight, leaving a one-dimensional invariant. Counts for all smaller square boards were regenerated; the source separately supplies their integral matching certificate for no torsion.
